title: Satchel Paige 2024 Topps Stadium Club Red Foil - St. Louis Browns
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Topps Stadium Club trading card featuring Satchel Paige of the St. Louis Browns. This red foil parallel variety card is not autographed and is card number 278 in the set. It is a Major League Baseball card manufactured by Topps for the 2024 season, showcasing unique design and collectible value.
